descriptions: msg points to params[0].memref.buffer (shared memory) and msg_len is REE-controlled; hashing reads directly from the shared buffer without first copying to private memory, so the REE can modify the message during/around the digest operation (TOCTOU/integrity violation).

TEE_DigestUpdate reads message bytes directly from params[0].memref.buffer (shared memory) using REE-controlled msg_len, without first copying the message into trusted-private memory; the REE can modify the shared buffer during/around this operation, creating a TOCTOU/integrity violation for the digest/signature computation.

TEE_DigestUpdate reads message bytes directly from msg, which aliases params[0].memref.buffer (shared memory). Because the TA does not first copy the message into trusted-private memory, the REE can modify the buffer while hashing is in progress, creating a shared-memory integrity/TOCTOU hazard for the computed digest/signature.
